name: PIXPRO CORE
headline: Reliable everyday performance
summary: The PIXPRO SATA SSD is designed to deliver a practical balance of speed, reliability, and efficiency for everyday computing. It is ideal for upgrading older laptops or building dependable desktop systems.

sections.title: Engineered for Everyday Excellence
sections.body: The PIXPRO SATA SSD provides faster boot times, smoother application performance, and a more responsive computing experience. Built with premium components, it is engineered to keep up with daily demands.

sections.title: Faster Performance, Better Productivity
sections.body: With sequential read speeds of up to 560 MB/s, PIXPRO CORE offers a noticeable improvement over traditional hard drives for startup, application loading, file transfers, and multitasking.

sections.title: Built for Reliability
sections.body: Every PIXPRO SATA SSD is manufactured using high-quality 3D NAND Flash and advanced controller technology, then subjected to quality and reliability testing for stable long-term operation.

sections.title: Efficient, Silent, and Durable
sections.body: With no moving parts, the drive operates silently while consuming less power and generating less heat than conventional hard drives. Its shock-resistant design supports reliable everyday use.

sections.title: Compatible with Your System
sections.body: Designed with a standard 2.5-inch SATA III interface, PIXPRO CORE offers broad compatibility with most desktops and laptops for simple storage upgrades.

features: Silent operation with no moving parts

name: PIXPRO EDGE
headline: High-speed performance for gamers and professionals
summary: Built on the PCIe Gen3 x4 interface, PIXPRO EDGE delivers responsive NVMe performance for everyday users, professionals, creators, and gamers.

sections.title: Unleash Everyday Performance
sections.body: PIXPRO EDGE helps users boot systems, launch applications, and transfer large files faster. It is designed for everyday computing, creative workloads, gaming, and professional use.

sections.title: High-Speed Performance
sections.body: Sequential read speeds of up to 3,500 MB/s and write speeds of up to 3,000 MB/s deliver a strong upgrade from traditional SATA SSDs.

sections.title: Built for Reliability
sections.body: Premium 3D NAND Flash, an advanced controller, and intelligent firmware work together to deliver stable and consistent performance.

sections.title: Optimized Power Efficiency
sections.body: PIXPRO EDGE balances speed with low power consumption. Efficient thermal management helps maintain stable operation during extended workloads.

sections.title: Designed for Every Workload
sections.body: Its compact M.2 2280 form factor makes it suitable for desktops, laptops, workstations, gaming systems, and professional environments.

sections.title: Quality You Can Trust
sections.body: Every PIXPRO SSD is tested for performance, compatibility, and reliability before reaching customers.

features: Sequential read speeds up to 3,500 MB/s
Sequential write speeds up to 3,000 MB/s

name: PIXPRO FLEX
headline: Value-focused, high-capacity storage
summary: PIXPRO FLEX is designed for users who demand speed, reliability, and efficiency for gaming, content creation, professional workloads, and everyday computing.

sections.title: Power Your Everyday Performance
sections.body: Built on the PCIe Gen3 x4 interface, PIXPRO FLEX delivers the balance of high-speed storage and dependable durability needed for modern PCs.

sections.title: Blazing-Fast PCIe Gen3 Performance
sections.body: Sequential read speeds of up to 3,500 MB/s and write speeds of up to 3,200 MB/s help reduce waiting time across booting, app launches, editing, and data transfers.

sections.title: Premium 3D TLC NAND Technology
sections.body: High-quality 3D TLC NAND Flash, an advanced NVMe controller, and intelligent firmware optimization help ensure stable performance during intensive workloads.

sections.title: Intelligent Performance and Power Efficiency
sections.body: The drive is engineered to maximize performance while minimizing power consumption. Intelligent thermal management helps maintain consistent operating temperatures.

sections.title: Designed for Reliability
sections.body: Every PIXPRO SSD undergoes comprehensive quality inspections and performance validation before leaving production.

sections.title: Built for Every User
sections.body: The M.2 2280 form factor makes PIXPRO FLEX suitable for desktops, laptops, gaming systems, workstations, and business applications.

features: Sequential read speeds up to 3,500 MB/s
Sequential write speeds up to 3,200 MB/s
Up to 570K/600K IOPS random read/write performance
TRIM, S.M.A.R.T, and Garbage Collection support
Low power consumption with intelligent thermal management

specifications.label: Sequential Write Speed
specifications.value: Up to 3,200 MB/s (2TB and 1TB), up to 3,100 MB/s (500GB)

specifications.label: Queue Support
specifications.value: Up to 256 Queues, up to 1,024 Queue Depth per Queue
